name: Parametrised triangle addition
summary: Two parametrised triangles in sequence, with parameters r and s, equal one with parameter r + s.
description: The parametrised triangle of Jeandel, Perdrix and Vilmart is the matrix $\begin{pmatrix}1&r\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$ (read from its tip to its base), and these matrices multiply by adding their parameters. Together with the [decomposition (TD)](../param-triangle-decomposition/) this gives the ring structure of $\mathbb C$, which replaces the λ-boxes and the addition rule of Ng and Wang. In the paper the triangles are drawn in red.
unchecked_reason: the parametrised triangle is not a generator of PyZX or ZXLive
